title: SCDBench: A Benchmark for LLM-Based Smart Contract Decompilers
abstract: arXiv:2605.29059v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Smart contract decompilation aims to recover high-level source code from bytecode, but evaluating decompilers remains difficult because existing studies use narrow datasets, inconsistent metrics, and limited semantic consistency checks. This gap is increasingly important as large language models (LLMs) begin to generate source-like Solidity that may compile and appear plausible, even when its semantics diverge from the original contract. We introduce SCDBench, a dataset and benchmark methodology for LLM-based smart contract decompilation. The dataset contains 600 real-world Solidity contracts with paired bytecode inputs, ground-truth source code, and replayable semantic checkpoints. SCDBench evaluates decompiler outputs through four cumulative stages: format completeness, compilability, Application Binary Interface (ABI) recovery, and semantic consistency via differential replay. We evaluate Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.3-Codex, and GLM-5

translated_title: SCDBench：一个面向基于大语言模型的智能合约反编译器的基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.29059v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：智能合约反编译旨在从字节码中恢复高级源代码，但由于现有研究使用的数据集范围狭窄、评估指标不一致、语义一致性检查有限，评估反编译器仍然十分困难。随着大语言模型（LLM）开始生成可能编译通过且看起来合理的类源代码 Solidity 代码——即使其语义与原始合约存在偏差——这一评估空白变得日益重要。我们提出了 SCDBench，一个用于基于 LLM 的智能合约反编译的数据集与基准测试方法。该数据集包含 600 个真实世界的 Solidity 合约，配有成对的字节码输入、真实源代码（ground truth）以及可重放的语义检查点。SCDBench 通过四个累积阶段评估反编译器的输出：格式完整性、可编译性、应用程序二进制接口（ABI）恢复，以及通过差分重放实现的语义一致性。我们评估了 Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5.3-Codex 和 GLM-5（摘要此处截断）。
tldr: SCDBench 提出了一个包含 600 个真实 Solidity 合约的数据集，通过格式完整性、可编译性、ABI 恢复和差分重放语义一致性四个累积阶段，对基于大语言模型的智能合约反编译器进行系统化评估，解决了现有评估方法数据集狭窄、指标不一致的问题。
en_tdlr: SCDBench introduces a benchmark of 600 real-world Solidity contracts with a four-stage cumulative evaluation pipeline—format completeness, compilability, ABI recovery, and semantic consistency via differential replay—to systematically assess LLM-based smart contract decompilers.
